steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the default event type to an auction.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the requested product as one line item with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet required for publication.

args.goal: on the single-stage auction create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes as None, leave Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory unticked, click Done, and stop with both clauses visible

steps.note: Configure the two event-wise terms because no domain step directly edits terms and conditions.
Invite one QA vendor for Vendor A's bid.
Commit the 30-minute schedule while retaining the default start-now behavior.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Move to the separate supplier portal session for Vendor A.
Open the event's pricing round as the invited vendor.
Verify the first clause is displayed to the vendor.
Verify the second clause is displayed to the vendor.
Have the vendor accept the first clause.
Have the vendor accept the second clause.
Submit a quote of 100 for the line after accepting both clauses.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer session to inspect the submitted bid and term state.
Verify the first clause remains visible on the buyer side.
Verify the buyer-side record marks the first clause as accepted.
Verify the second clause remains visible on the buyer side.
Verify the buyer-side record marks the second clause as accepted.
